patch_description: Composition of the two strongest prior generations: a percentile-blended 3-scale Savitzky-Golay kernel bank (half-widths [sg_half//2, sg_half, 2·sg_half], Gaussian weights centered at the 20/50/80th percentiles of local volatility) applied on top of the RTS-smoothed Kalman level, combined with the confidence-gated trend lead from Gen 45 (the 0.63 combined-score anchor with lag 0.30) and the volatility-scheduled Q from Gen 46. The wider third scale (2·sg_half instead of 1.5·sg_half) increases smoothing depth in volatile regions, further reducing noise reduction error and slope reversals, while the tanh confidence gate on the MAD-scaled slope channel advances only statistically significant trends — keeping lag low where it matters and flat where the signal is quiet. All stages are O(n) convolutions and 2×2 matrix recursions, preserving the 1.00 efficiency score.
